notes.content: The page summarizes a proposed starting point: two orders on the family F with F ≤ G implying F ≪ G; M and L are then recalled by references, and two applications interpret F through its deployment and its Fig family. It ends by asserting that ≤ becomes inclusion of deployments.
notes.math_reading_decisions: The literal reference is (1.25), without adopting H’s cross-page correction. The operator is literally Dep(F), without acute or final l. All displayed set separators are single vertical strokes and inclusions are open subset signs. Four order labels sit directly underneath their signs. The first source is X corrected to F; the second source retains state alternatives. Tildes and ordinary F/G/X/Y operands are preserved.
